name: cs
description: cs's in-session mod: the rotate band above the prompt, forced rotation past CS_ROTATE_FORCE_CTX, and the wrap key

bandPrompts.title: Band: prompt ticks
bandPrompts.description: Draw a tick per prompt on the band, and the name of one prompt before them; a press on a tick scrolls to its prompt. Off by default.

bandPrompt.title: Band: named prompt
bandPrompt.description: "latest" (default): the band names the newest prompt and draws its tick as ┃. "read": it names the prompt being read, the one whose row stands highest on screen, and follows your scroll.

bandBars.title: Band: most ticks
bandBars.description: The most prompt ticks the band draws (default 10); older prompts fold into one …N run. A whole number of 1 or more.
